name: Flashcards
description: Review your language flashcards on your glasses — earning XP and syncing progress with your account.

settings.label: Site URL
settings.hint: The address of your flashcard site, e.g. https://canto-ank.silcoff-labs.ca

settings.label: API token
settings.hint: Generate this in the site's Settings → Even glasses, then paste it here.

settings.label: Swap tap / hold
settings.hint: By default a short press = 'got it' and a long press = 'missed it'. Turn on to swap them.
